shared_preload_libraries.description: Comma-separated list of shared libraries to preload at PostgreSQL startup. Must include 'pg_stat_kcache' for this extension to work.

pg_stat_kcache_level.description: Level of statistics to collect: 'none' (no stats), 'user' (user CPU only), 'kernel' (kernel CPU only), or 'all' (user + kernel).

pg_stat_kcache_top_k_queries.description: Maximum number of top queries to retain statistics for per database. Set to 0 to disable limits.

pg_stat_kcache_reset_on_dump.description: If true, reset collected statistics when pg_dump is run.

pg_stat_kcache_database_rules.description: List of per-database inclusion/exclusion rules for statistics collection.

database.description: Database name to apply this rule to.

include.description: If true, include queries from databases matching 'pattern'; if false, exclude them.

pattern.description: SQL LIKE pattern to match database names (e.g., 'myapp_*', '%production%').

pg_stat_kcache_sample_rate.description: Maximum number of samples per second per query. Set to 0 for unlimited (collect every sample).

pg_stat_kcache_track_time.description: If true, track kernel/user CPU time per query (requires kernel support).

pg_stat_kcache_track_io.description: If true, track I/O stats (bytes read/written, reads/writes count) per query.

pg_stat_kcache_track_context.description: If true, track context switches and page faults per query (expensive; use only for deep profiling).
